In this text, a celestial being (*deva*) explains the karmic fruits that led to their rebirth in a heavenly mansion, specifically recounting the beneficial consequences of offering a garland of flowers to the Supreme Buddha [SuttaCentral]. The text has five translations listed in five different languages on SuttaCentral [SuttaCentral].
